# ractermx_statistics (Data Source)

Reads aggregated email statistics for the account.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `date_from` (String) Start date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to 30 days ago.
- `date_to` (String) End date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today.

### Read-Only

- `total_bounced` (Number) Total emails bounced.
- `total_bytes` (Number) Total bytes received.
- `total_deferred` (Number) Total emails deferred.
- `total_forwarded` (Number) Total emails forwarded.
- `total_received` (Number) Total emails received.
- `total_rejected` (Number) Total emails rejected.
